purpose: Requested pnpm migration; pre-execution package-manager assessment
decision: Migration blocked by known vulnerabilities in every inspected candidate; active application manifests, npm lock, installed packages and frozen worker locks remain unchanged.
security_scope: Codespace incomplete-evidence exception does not waive confirmed vulnerabilities. No new vulnerability exception requested or inferred.

sources.blocked_sources_reason: Network proxy returned HTTP 403 during this review.

method: Python standard-library HTTP/archive/manifest inspection; SHA-512 registry-integrity comparison; OpenSSL registry ECDSA signature verification. No newly downloaded scanner or package-manager code executed. No container/OS dependency changed.
publisher_review: Registry metadata points to pnpm/pnpm and maintainers zkochan/pnpmuser. Registry signatures verified against fetched registry keys; attestations retained. Independent recent incident review and full executable provenance are incomplete because known findings already block execution. No malware-free guarantee.

candidates.name: pnpm
candidates.provenance_verification: Registry attestation downloaded; SLSA/Rekor identity verification not completed after known-findings stop. Registry signature does not prove publisher compromise absent.
candidates.graph_coverage: 10.x: packaged manifests plus bundle module-path version references. 11.x/12.x: packaged manifests only; compiled/optional executables not fully inventoried. Review stopped on confirmed packaged findings.
candidates.automatic_execution: No tarball code, lifecycle hook, pnpm CLI or optional executable was run. 12.x root preinstall/postinstall invokes install.js; 10.x/11.x root has no install hooks. Bundled package hooks were inspected as data only.
